-- Verificação final
SELECT 'allowed_clients' as tabela, COUNT(*) as testes_restantes FROM allowed_clients 
WHERE LOWER(name) LIKE '%teste%' OR LOWER(name) LIKE '%test%' OR LOWER(name) = 'new client'
UNION ALL
SELECT 'employees', COUNT(*) FROM employees 
WHERE LOWER(name) LIKE '%teste%' OR LOWER(name) LIKE '%test%'
UNION ALL
SELECT 'users', COUNT(*) FROM users 
WHERE LOWER(name) LIKE '%teste%' OR LOWER(name) LIKE '%test%' OR LOWER(email) LIKE '%test%'
UNION ALL
SELECT 'bookings', COUNT(*) FROM bookings 
WHERE LOWER(client_name) LIKE '%teste%' OR LOWER(client_name) LIKE '%test%';
